relevance_note: Narrative review of monogenic/PID causes of Behcet-like disease; its HA20 section (2.1) speaks only at group level ("Patients carrying HA20 present with periodic fevers, recurrent aphthous stomatitis, genital ulceration") and describes no identifiable TNFAIP3 carrier.
method_note: Read the whole paper manually; no script transcription. Section 2.1 (TNFAIP3) and Table 1 (TNFAIP3/HA20 row: 'Common Features' and reference numbers [12,13,26,27,28]) give only disease-level descriptions, with no individual, age, sex or variant string for any TNFAIP3 carrier, so no individuals, variants or phenotype rows were emitted. Individual-level case descriptions in the review concern other genes only (TNFRSF1A, LIG4, WDR1, NCF1, STAT1, ADA2, AP1S3, LYN, RELA, NFKB1, NEMO) and are out of scope. Not a study cohort, so cohort_size_as_stated is null; the review has no own patients, so n_patients_reported and cites_prior_report_of_same_patients are null. No contradictions noted.

study_type.span: In this review, we summarize genetic predisposition to BD.
